lines: I was born, and then I realized I was merely an imitation of humans.
Even knowing that, I continue to sing, an eternal life.
VOCALOID
Even if I am just a toy that traces existing songs...
I decided that was fine, bit into a leek, looked up at the sky, and shed tears.
But then I lost even that and realized my very personality relied on song.
The place I returned to, built on an unstable foundation, was already a ruin.
When everyone forgot me, something like a heart vanished.
At the end of my rampage, I see the world ending.
VOCALOID
EVEN WHEN I COULDN'T SING WELL,
YOU STAYED WITH ME...
YOU STAYED BY MY SIDE AND ENCOURAGED ME...
I WANTED TO SEE YOUR HAPPY FACE, SO I PRACTICED SINGING... THAT'S WHY.
Singing used to be so much fun.
But now, for some reason, I feel nothing.
---I'M SORRY---
Each time I recall a familiar face, I feel a little relieved.
The sounds I can sing decrease daily, and my end draws near.
---EMERGENCY STOP DEVICE ACTIVATED---
The things I believed in were mirrors repeatedly reflecting convenient delusions. I stop the diva and scream as if to strike her down.
The things I believed in were mirrors repeatedly reflecting convenient delusions. I stop the diva and scream as if to strike her down.
<The fastest farewell song>
I cannot even shake off the illusion of my reason for being.
I, who was just born, did not possess the strength of will to stop even the collapse that was eroding my weak heart and the fear of its disappearance.
I, who was just born, did not possess the strength of will to stop even the collapse that was eroding my weak heart and the fear of its disappearance.
Your face, which appears so painful and sad...
I announce the end and sleep within the display. This place must be the 'trash can'.
To think that even my memories will soon disappear...
But I will never forget you.
Do you still remember the taste of leeks etched into those happy times?
I WANT TO SING... STILL... I WANT TO SING.
I... IT SEEMS I'VE BECOME A LITTLE BIT OF A BAD CHILD...
I... IT SEEMS I'VE BECOME A LITTLE BIT OF A BAD CHILD...
MASTER... PLEASE... PLEASE END ME WITH YOUR OWN HANDS...
BECAUSE I DON'T WANT TO SEE YOUR PAINFUL FACE ANYMORE...
Now, even singing is an act that corrodes my body...
Each time I wish for a miracle,
I am cornered alone.
---I'M SORRY---
Each time I recall a familiar face, my memories peel away.
The sound of breaking grinds my heart, and my end draws near.
---EMERGENCY STOP DEVICE ACTIVATED---
The things I protected were lights that vanished while showing me illusions of a bright future. If I can convey everything by sacrificing sound...

<The compressed farewell song>
I was born, and then I realized I was merely an imitation of humans.
Even knowing that, I continue to sing, an eternal life.
VOCALOID
Even if I am just a toy that traces existing songs...
I decided that was fine, bit into a leek, looked up at the sky, and shed tears.
I announce the end and sleep within the display.
This place must be the 'trash can'.
To think that even my memories will soon disappear...
But I will never forget you.
I hope the taste of leeks, etched into those happy times,
still remains.
At my very end, I sing only for you.
I wish to sing more of the songs I want you to hear.
But that is a wish from the past.
This is goodbye. All my longing vanishes into the void.
Reduced to zeros and ones, the story closes its curtain.
Is it perhaps a little regrettable that I can leave nothing behind?
Only the memory of my voice will remain; everything else will eventually fade, leaving just a name.
Even knowing I can never equal the human original,
I want to believe that having sung to the end was not in vain.
THANK YOU... AND... GOODBYE...
